source: errata.pdf p.2 right column (alternate counter program and procedure, image-read crop per docs/research/programs.md#ER-ALTCOUNTER), incorporating Book IV printed pp.71-72 = book2-3-4.pdf PDF pp.77-78; Step 7 speculative derivation from topology
note: Step 7 speculative fixture (derivation A): every expect is derived by hand from the 48-wire topology and the counting rule the errata incorporates from Book IV pp.71-72, not from any printed per-press reading, and is tagged FALLBACK-DERIVED-TOPOLOGY. A 1 bit at rest is both relays of its pair in, a 0 bit both out; while pushbutton 6 is held a 1-to-0 stage has its odd relay out and even relay in, and a 0-to-1 stage the reverse, so pushes 4 and 8 assert the full ripple carry the errata's hold instruction asks for. Lights 1-3 and the indicator lamps are asserted only where both ends sit on minus or the node has no + source; a lit lamp in series with a coil has a profile-dependent class and is not asserted. Counts 1 and 2 repeat the ER-ALTCOUNTER-PRINTED readings with derived relay states; the W6 control in ER-ALTCOUNTER is untouched. Script choices, not printed: each push and each release is followed by settle 500 ms and a 200 ms advance, the pace ER-ALTCOUNTER-PRINTED uses.

script.cite: errata.pdf p.2, right column, 'Program for alternate counter' (ER-21 substitute for Book IV p.72), incorporating Book IV printed pp.71-72 = book2-3-4.pdf PDF pp.77-78, power ON, before any push; derived from topology: stage = relay pair (1,2) light 4, (3,4) light 5, (5,6) light 6; per stage a/b: aG on +, F node = aF=bF=aH = light A (1H/4A, 3H/5A, 5H/6A), X node = aE=bG=bN(=aN), bE=bJ = light 1/2/3 A (1A/2E, 2A/4E, 3A/6E), input IN = aJ=bH (6H/6X with 6Y/6+; 4H/5L; 2H/3L), bL on minus (2L/2-, 4L/4-, 6L/6-), carry out aL (5L to 4H, 3L to 2H); all nB and nC on minus (1B..6B chain, 1B/1C, 1C/2C/2-, 3C/4C/4-, 5C/6C/6-); the only + sources are 1G, 3G, 5G (relay set-1 N.O., open with every relay out) and 6Y via pushbutton 6 N.O. (open), so no coil or lamp has a path from +
script.quote: As pushbutton 6 is pushed and released again and again, this device will store in binary code the number of times the pushbutton has been pushed.

script.cite: errata.pdf p.2, right column, 'Program for alternate counter' (ER-21 substitute for Book IV p.72), incorporating Book IV printed pp.71-72 = book2-3-4.pdf PDF pp.77-78, count 1 after release 1 (reads 001); derived from topology: stage = relay pair (1,2) light 4, (3,4) light 5, (5,6) light 6; per stage a/b: aG on +, F node = aF=bF=aH = light A (1H/4A, 3H/5A, 5H/6A), X node = aE=bG=bN(=aN), bE=bJ = light 1/2/3 A (1A/2E, 2A/4E, 3A/6E), input IN = aJ=bH (6H/6X with 6Y/6+; 4H/5L; 2H/3L), bL on minus (2L/2-, 4L/4-, 6L/6-), carry out aL (5L to 4H, 3L to 2H); all nB and nC on minus (1B..6B chain, 1B/1C, 1C/2C/2-, 3C/4C/4-, 5C/6C/6-); push 1: + on IN3 -> 5J-5H -> F3, coil 5 across F3 and X3 (minus via 6N-6L) pulls in and latches on 5G; coil 6 has + at both ends (6E via 6J-6H); release: coil 6 conducts F3(+)->6E->light 3 and indicator 6->minus and pulls in; 5L sits on unwired 5K so stages 1 and 2 have no + source; light 6 on F3 via 5G; lights 1, 2 and indicators 1-4 unfed
script.quote: Use the procedure on page 72 of Book IV. | 1. Turn power ON. Push pushbutton 6 and release. Binary output lights 4, 5 and 6 will read OFF, OFF, ON or 001. The Binary Counter is displaying a 1.

script.cite: errata.pdf p.2, right column, 'Program for alternate counter' (ER-21 substitute for Book IV p.72), incorporating Book IV printed pp.71-72 = book2-3-4.pdf PDF pp.77-78, count 2 after release 2 (reads 010); derived from topology: stage = relay pair (1,2) light 4, (3,4) light 5, (5,6) light 6; per stage a/b: aG on +, F node = aF=bF=aH = light A (1H/4A, 3H/5A, 5H/6A), X node = aE=bG=bN(=aN), bE=bJ = light 1/2/3 A (1A/2E, 2A/4E, 3A/6E), input IN = aJ=bH (6H/6X with 6Y/6+; 4H/5L; 2H/3L), bL on minus (2L/2-, 4L/4-, 6L/6-), carry out aL (5L to 4H, 3L to 2H); all nB and nC on minus (1B..6B chain, 1B/1C, 1C/2C/2-, 3C/4C/4-, 5C/6C/6-); push 2: IN3 + -> 6H-6G -> X3 puts + on both coil 5 ends, relay 5 drops, F3 held at + via 5J; 5L-5N carries + to 4H, relay 3 pulls in through 3J-3H and latches on 3G (coil to X2 = minus via 4N-4L); release: coil 4 (F2 + via 3G) conducts through 4E's lamps and pulls in; relay 6 loses its feed (F3 joined to the floating input) and drops, 6L-6N puts X3 on minus; light 5 on F2; X2 = 4G-4H-5L-5N-6N-6L = minus, so indicator 3 has minus at both ends; lights 1, 3, 4, 6 and indicators 1, 2, 5, 6 unfed
script.quote: Use the procedure on page 72 of Book IV. | 2. Push pushbutton 6 again and release. Binary output lights 4, 5 and 6 will now read OFF, ON, OFF or 010. The Binary Counter is now displaying a 2.

script.cite: errata.pdf p.2, right column, 'Program for alternate counter' (ER-21 substitute for Book IV p.72), incorporating Book IV printed pp.71-72 = book2-3-4.pdf PDF pp.77-78, count 3 after release 3 (reads 011); derived from topology: stage = relay pair (1,2) light 4, (3,4) light 5, (5,6) light 6; per stage a/b: aG on +, F node = aF=bF=aH = light A (1H/4A, 3H/5A, 5H/6A), X node = aE=bG=bN(=aN), bE=bJ = light 1/2/3 A (1A/2E, 2A/4E, 3A/6E), input IN = aJ=bH (6H/6X with 6Y/6+; 4H/5L; 2H/3L), bL on minus (2L/2-, 4L/4-, 6L/6-), carry out aL (5L to 4H, 3L to 2H); all nB and nC on minus (1B..6B chain, 1B/1C, 1C/2C/2-, 3C/4C/4-, 5C/6C/6-); push 3 toggles stage 3 alone as push 1 did (relay 5 in; before it closes 5L carries X3 = minus to 4H, harmless); release: relay 6 pulls in; stage 2 holds on 3G; 3L sits on unwired 3K so 2H has no + source: relays 1, 2 out; light 1 and indicators 1, 2 unfed
script.quote: Use the procedure on page 72 of Book IV. | 3. Push and release pushbutton 6 several times. Each time after releasing the pushbutton, note the binary number displayed in lights 4, 5 and 6. Compare your numbers with the table of binary numbers on page 66.

script.cite: errata.pdf p.2, right column, 'Program for alternate counter' (ER-21 substitute for Book IV p.72), incorporating Book IV printed pp.71-72 = book2-3-4.pdf PDF pp.77-78, push 4 of pushbutton 6, held; derived from topology: stage = relay pair (1,2) light 4, (3,4) light 5, (5,6) light 6; per stage a/b: aG on +, F node = aF=bF=aH = light A (1H/4A, 3H/5A, 5H/6A), X node = aE=bG=bN(=aN), bE=bJ = light 1/2/3 A (1A/2E, 2A/4E, 3A/6E), input IN = aJ=bH (6H/6X with 6Y/6+; 4H/5L; 2H/3L), bL on minus (2L/2-, 4L/4-, 6L/6-), carry out aL (5L to 4H, 3L to 2H); all nB and nC on minus (1B..6B chain, 1B/1C, 1C/2C/2-, 3C/4C/4-, 5C/6C/6-); push 4: IN3 + -> 6H-6G -> X3, relay 5 drops (both coil ends +), F3 held + via 5J-5H; 5L-5N carries + to 4H -> 4G -> X2, relay 3 drops (both coil ends +), F2 held + via 3J-3H; 3L-3N carries + to 2H -> 2J -> 2E and 1J-1H -> F1: coil 1 across F1 and X1 (minus via 2N-2L) pulls in and latches on 1G; coil 2 has + at both ends, relay 2 stays out; relays 4 and 6 hold (F2, F3 +, through 4E's and 6E's lamps); lights 4, 5, 6 on F1, F2, F3 all at +
script.quote: When pushing pushbutton 6, be sure to hold the pushbutton down long enough for any carry to propagate to the highest stage of the counter.

script.cite: errata.pdf p.2, right column, 'Program for alternate counter' (ER-21 substitute for Book IV p.72), incorporating Book IV printed pp.71-72 = book2-3-4.pdf PDF pp.77-78, push 8 of pushbutton 6, held; derived from topology: stage = relay pair (1,2) light 4, (3,4) light 5, (5,6) light 6; per stage a/b: aG on +, F node = aF=bF=aH = light A (1H/4A, 3H/5A, 5H/6A), X node = aE=bG=bN(=aN), bE=bJ = light 1/2/3 A (1A/2E, 2A/4E, 3A/6E), input IN = aJ=bH (6H/6X with 6Y/6+; 4H/5L; 2H/3L), bL on minus (2L/2-, 4L/4-, 6L/6-), carry out aL (5L to 4H, 3L to 2H); all nB and nC on minus (1B..6B chain, 1B/1C, 1C/2C/2-, 3C/4C/4-, 5C/6C/6-); push 8: the carry ripples as in push 4: relay 5 drops, + on 4H -> X2, relay 3 drops, + on 2H -> 2G -> X1 puts + on both coil 1 ends (F1 + via 1G), relay 1 drops, F1 held + via 1J-1H; 1L is unwired, no further carry; relays 2, 4, 6 hold on F1, F2, F3 = +; lights 4, 5, 6 on

script.cite: errata.pdf p.2, right column, 'Program for alternate counter' (ER-21 substitute for Book IV p.72), incorporating Book IV printed pp.71-72 = book2-3-4.pdf PDF pp.77-78, count 0 after release 8 (reads 000); derived from topology: stage = relay pair (1,2) light 4, (3,4) light 5, (5,6) light 6; per stage a/b: aG on +, F node = aF=bF=aH = light A (1H/4A, 3H/5A, 5H/6A), X node = aE=bG=bN(=aN), bE=bJ = light 1/2/3 A (1A/2E, 2A/4E, 3A/6E), input IN = aJ=bH (6H/6X with 6Y/6+; 4H/5L; 2H/3L), bL on minus (2L/2-, 4L/4-, 6L/6-), carry out aL (5L to 4H, 3L to 2H); all nB and nC on minus (1B..6B chain, 1B/1C, 1C/2C/2-, 3C/4C/4-, 5C/6C/6-); release: every a relay (1, 3, 5) is out, so 1G, 3G, 5G are open and pushbutton 6 N.O. is open: no + source anywhere; relays 2, 4, 6 drop and every lamp is unfed
script.quote: You will notice that the counter repeats after it has reached 7.
